english.title: Registered person contravene / fail to obtain two certificates of opinion prior to terminating pregnancy
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person registered with the Care Quality Commission carrying out a regulated activity consisting of the termination of pregnancies, namely **(..SPECIFY SERVICE NAME..), where a termination of pregnancy had been carried out in respect of a service user, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME..), failed to ensure that two certificates of opinion had been obtained
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 20(2) and 25 of the Care Quality Commission (Registration) Regulations 2009.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Regulation 20(1) states the offence only applies to a registered person who carries on / manages the regulated activity of the termination of pregnancies and is not an English NHS body.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), the defendant was a person registered with the Care Quality Commission carrying out a regulated activity consisting of the termination of pregnancies, namely **(..SPECIFY SERVICE NAME..), where a termination of pregnancy had been carried out in respect of a service user, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME..), failed to ensure that two certificates of opinion had been obtained.
